name: alliance-hcm-monorepo
description: Alliance HCM – Core TH & IT (Fase 1 MVP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@alliance-hcm/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@alliance-hcm/web"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/shared && npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/database
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/api && npm run build --workspace=@alliance-hcm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@alliance-hcm/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alliance-hcm/database && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alliance-hcm/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@alliance-hcm/web
